mentions.name: TalkShoe clone
mentions.description: A clone of the old podcasting website TalkShoe, built as a way to learn more about Asterisk and telephony, aiming to be fully usable within a month or two.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also been working on a clone of the old podcasting website TalkShoe.  It's nothing too complicated.  It's mostly an excuse to learn a bit more about Asterisk and telephony stuff. I'm hoping to have something fully usable in about a month or two.
